messages:
incident-bot: Pager duty alert: SMART-ROUTING policy error rate > 10% in eu-west-1 for /v1/generate (affected: model_variant mismatch + cache hits). Incident id INC-2026-8453. Paging oncall.
Avery L: acked. I'm oncall for infra today, grabbing it. can someone drop a quick symptom summary?
oncall-ops: routing errors spike + elevated 502s downstream, some customers reporting weird completions (short, truncated, wrong style).
Maya R: seeing a pattern on traces — when fallback to regional-cap weak capacity occurs it picks a different variant (quantized-nightly) but cache keys don't include variant tag so KV cache returns tokens produced by a different variant.
Samir P: whoa. so the KV prefix is model:1234:region:eu-west but NOT variant_id? that would cause cross-variant reuse.
Maya R: exact. scoped_key = f"kv:{model_id}:{region}:{prefix}" from routing v2.1.2. variant_id only present in serving header but not in cache namespace.
Nadia C: customers: two enterprise accounts flagged misaligned outputs (formatting + hallucination). CS flagged for possible data-sensitivity concerns.
Avery L: OK priority: 1) mitigate customer impact 2) prevent further cache reuse 3) patch routing+cache key.
Samir P: quick mitigation options: 1) disable KV cache for eu-west and fall back to cold serving 2) force routing to only use model variant pinned to production (no fallback) 3) flush region kv namespaces. Which is fastest?
Maya R: fastest = toggle kv cache off for the region (config flip). flushing shard safe but could be slow if large. pinning routing to exact variant is also quick via policy change.
Avery L: do both: disable KV and pin routing to stable variant. I'll apply config change to routing policy and request ops to disable kv.
Avery L: @deploy-bot apply-config routing.policy.smart_fallback.eu-west1.pin_variant=prod-2026-01 || /deploy returns: queued
deploy-bot: config apply queued by Avery L - change id cfg-195861-01.
Samir P: ops, disable kv cache on eu-west1 now? command: ```ssh ops@kv-cluster-eu-1 'curl -XPOST http://localhost:9000/admin/disable-cache?namespace=region-eu-west'```
oncall-ops: running now, will post status.
oncall-ops: done — KV cache disabled for namespace region-eu-west. reported: 0 errors on command. Cache hit rate will drop to 0 until re-enabled.
Maya R: throwing an emergency canary to verify responses look correct after change. running 200 synthetic requests vs prod traffic pattern.
Maya R: canary results: latency + throughput acceptable, quality looks restored for pinned variant. No cross-variant tokens returned.
Nadia C: notifying affected customers with interim note: we mitigated routing and disabled regional cache; CS will follow up.
Samir P: next: we need a code fix to include variant_id in KV key generation and add a safe migration plan. Also add automated tests to detect cross-variant cache reuse.
Avery L: Agreed. Maya, can you open an RFC/bug and PR for the patch? Prioritize high.
Maya R: creating ticket INFRA-1219 and PR now. Patch adds variant_id to key: ```scoped_key = f"kv:{model_id}:{variant_id}:{region}:{prefix}"``` and updates compatibility upgrade path to include a key-version header so we can safely invalidate older keys.
Maya R: PR created: https://repo/internal/pull/3421 - includes migration script to TTL existing keys for 24h and add header-based eviction job.
Samir P: will run rollout plan: canary -> gradual 10% -> 50% -> all. Also adding a temporary metric that alerts on cache_hit_mismatch where response_variant != cached_variant.
Avery L: assigning postmortem lead to Samir. timeline: incident opened 1958612345, mitigated by config flips 1958612472, cache disabled 1958612481, canary green 1958612600.
Samir P: starting postmortem doc draft. early impact: ~0.8% requests in eu-west returned wrong-variant tokens during the 18 minute window. two paying customers reported degraded output; no evidence of exfiltration.
Nadia C: CS outreach: two customers contacted; one requested immediate rollback of changes (we explained), both accepted interim mitigation and want writeup.
Avery L: handoff to second oncall Maya for overnight monitoring. tagging followups: infra patch, add unit/integration tests, alert rule for variant-key mismatch, customer writeups.
oncall-ops: confirmed monitoring running. will reopen if error rate > 2% for 5m.
Maya R: acked. I'll monitor synthetic canaries and game-day dashboards.
Avery L: thanks all. closing the pager for now — move to post-incident follow-ups in #incidents-postmortems.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-8453 marked resolved by Avery L at 1958612898.
Samir P: posting short timeline & remediation in the postmortem channel later today.
Maya R: PR linked above includes migration patch. follow-up tasks: (1) QA test matrix for cache key schema (2) rollout playbook for variant-pinning on fallback (3) CS-ready customer note template.
Nadia C: I'll prepare the customer note and loop legal if any additional review needed.
Avery L: great work. final note: enable a synthetic check that compares cached token provenance vs current variant header every 1m.
